en.html:
Hanae"Just now, between 'more accurately' and 'take aim', I heard something."
Kanae"Perhaps your ears are imagining things?"
Hanae"Bhagwan knows they aren't."
Kanae"Uhuu... My own sister has no faith in me. Such sorrow."
Hanae"That fake crying just increased my distrust by fifty percent."
Kanae"That aside, could the foot be removed now? One confession from my side: polishing floorboards with my face is not among my favourite activities."
Hanae"Before that, a question."
Kanae"Afterward we cannot discuss?"
Hanae"Nahi. Depending on the answer, I break your neck right here."
Kanae"............"
Kanae"What?"
Hanae"Was it you who killed Yuhi?"
Kanae"————"
Kanae"That question. Are you serious?"
Hanae"............¦ ...¦ Sorry. Just said it."

en.html:
Kanae"Uff. What a cruel sister. Now there is dust in my hair."
Hanae"You know Yuhi is dead."
Kanae"Yes."
Hanae"Who did it?"
Kanae"..."
Hanae"Looks as if you know."
Kanae"...That matter, could you leave with me?"
Hanae"You mean to settle it by yourself?"
Kanae"............Yes."
Hanae"I was his fiancée."
Kanae"Even so."
Hanae"............ Afterward, at least you will explain?"
Kanae"Well, now..."
Hanae"..."
Hanae"Wah. Vague words given, question neatly dodged."
Kanae"I am sorry."

en.html:
Hanae"............"
Hanae"So. What have you come back for?"
Kanae"My beloved sister is in trouble. A magnificent entrance must be made. For that."
Hanae"...Entry maarna. That was the purpose."
Kanae"Rescue also I have done on the side. Properly."
Hanae"What's brought this on?"
Kanae"You find it strange?"
Hanae"Haan, strange. Till now you left me alone. No extra helping from your side."
Kanae"That seemed best. Also, how you would finish off that man—I was interested to see."
Hanae"Then why turn up now?"
Kanae"The present situation."
Hanae"The situation? ————Ah. That."
Hanae"You intend to kill Shishiku and prevent war with the occupation forces."
Kanae"Very perceptive."
Hanae"It would work, certainly. ...If that is your intention, leave it to me."
Hanae"I'll keep Shishiku alive another three years."
Kanae"Keep that quarter-foreign fellow alive, and unnecessary deaths will keep piling up, you know?"
Hanae"But in three years, I can take it all back."
Kanae"All?"
Hanae"Ootori. The shogunate. Kanto. Yamato."
Hanae"The continent."

花枝「なら、どうして今さら来たの」

花枝「情勢？ 　――――あぁ。そういうこと」
花枝「獅子吼を殺して、進駐軍との開戦を避ける つもりなのね」

花枝「確かに有効な手だけど。 　……そういうつもりなら、わたしに任せて おいて」

香奈枝「あの異人の孫クォーターを生かしておくと、要らない 人死がざくざく増えましてよ？」

香奈枝「全部？」
花枝「大鳥。 　幕府。 　関東。 　大和」
花枝「大陸」

en.html:
Kanae"............"
Hanae"You doubt it?"
Kanae"If I could doubt you, your didi would not have to be this frightened."
Hanae"Go home for today. Shishiku just recalled the warriors from outside. Time it so you miss them on the way."
Kanae"That side is taken care of. Sayo is holding the entrance. Until I kill Shishiku, no one is getting through."
Hanae"...Sun rahi thi? Were you listening? Shishiku is MY work, I'm saying."
Kanae"Achha. One question."
Hanae"What?"
Kanae"You are willing to be married off to His Highness Kuniuji?"
Hanae"————"
Hanae"...His Highness is not a bad boy."
Kanae"Standard rejection line. Nice boy, but no thank you."
Hanae"Chup. Born into a house like Ootori, and you expect to marry somebody you like? That would be the strange part."
Kanae"Political marriage. Noble family, noble duty, no?"
Hanae"Yes..."
Kanae"But once, I did have a dream."
Hanae"A dream?"
Kanae"Politics, haan. Parents decided, haan. Still, my little sister would marry someone she loved. A happy marriage, even so..."
Kanae"That sort of dream."

ja.html:
香奈枝「…………」
花枝「疑う？」
香奈枝「疑えたら、おねえちゃんこんなにビクビク しなくて済むんだけど」
花枝「今日は帰って。 　さっき獅子吼が外の武者を呼び戻していた から、うまく行き違いになるように」
香奈枝「そっちは大丈夫。 　さよに玄関を守らせてあるから。わたくし が獅子吼を殺すまで、誰も通れません」
花枝「……話、ちゃんと聞いてた？ 　獅子吼の始末は、わたしに任せろっての」
香奈枝「質問」
花枝「なに？」
香奈枝「邦氏殿下と結婚させられてもいいの？」
花枝「――――」
花枝「……殿下は、悪い子じゃない」
香奈枝「それ、交際の申し出を断る時の定番台詞」
花枝「うるさいな。 　もともと、大鳥のような家に生まれついて、 好きな相手と結婚できる方がおかしいんだ」
香奈枝「政略結婚は貴族の義務ですものねー」
花枝「そうだよ……」
香奈枝「でも一度、夢を見てしまいました」
花枝「夢？」
香奈枝「政略だけど。親の決めたことだけど。 　それでも妹の結婚は、好きな人と結ばれる、 幸福なものになる……」
香奈枝「そんな夢」

en.html:
Hanae"............"
Kanae"Think something is yours, then lose it. That is when greed really gets to work, no?"
Hanae"...What do you want me to do?"
Kanae"No compromise. Someday, a marriage where politics is happy and you are in love. Both things. Could you manage that for me?"
Hanae"Hadd hai. Ask for something possible."
Kanae"With your treacherous little brain? Such wicked cunning, and this small thing you cannot manage?"
Hanae"Confidence is not coming from that guarantee."
Kanae"Chalo. For my little sister's future love. They say a horse should kick meddlers in love to death; today I shall do the horse's duty."
Hanae"...And you're all right with that?"
Kanae"With what?"
Hanae"Because Shishiku is your—"
Kanae"Yes. For that reason."
Kanae"I want to settle it with my own hands. Forgive me, Hanae. This is the real reason."
Kanae"I do not want to hand that man over to you."
Hanae"............"
Kanae"Without a proper public justification, I was going to bear it. But what to do? Now the justification has arrived."
Kanae"Killing him now will save many lives in Yamato. And the one who can kill him now is I alone. You cannot."

　邪魔する男を、馬に代わって蹴り殺してき
ましょうか」花枝「……あんたは、それでいいの？」香奈枝「なにが？」花枝「だって。
　獅子吼は、あんたの――」香奈枝「ええ。
　だから・・・」香奈枝「わたくしの手で決着をつけたい。
　ごめんなさいね、花枝。ほんとうの理由は
こっち」香奈枝「あの男を、あなたに譲りたくないの」花枝「…………」香奈枝「大義名分が出来なければ、我慢するつもり
でいたのだけれど。
　出来ちゃったのよね、名分これが」香奈枝「あの男をいま殺しておく事は、大和の多く
の人々の命を救う事になる。
　そして、あの男をいま殺せるのはわたくし
だけ。あなたにはできない」

en.html:
Hanae"...Didi."
Kanae"So I am no longer leaving it to you. Listen, Hanae."
Kanae"Do not spoil your didi's fun."
Hanae"............ Anyone else said that, I would tell them: stop this clumsy attempt to be considerate."
Hanae"But what can I say? My sister means it. Literally. That is the whole problem."
Kanae"YES."
Hanae"Please consider yourself addressed by the word whose meaning is 'person whose mental condition is not normal'."
Kanae"Coming from you, that word has a special power to wound..."
Hanae"You want Father's revenge all to yourself as well?"
Kanae"Little sister's things are big sister's things. Big sister's things are big sister's things."
Hanae"............"
Hanae"Shishiku just went out to intercept you. Probably headed for the hall, I think."
Kanae"Why... that is where I came from. At what point did we manage to miss each other?"
Kanae"That man and I, apparently destiny is not managing to connect us."
Shishiku"No connection would have been a blessing. ...Unfortunately, we met long ago."
Kanae"!?"

ja.html:
花枝「……姉さん」
香奈枝「だから、あなたに任せるのはやめ。 　いいこと花枝？」
香奈枝「姉さんの楽しみ・・・を邪魔してはだめよ」
花枝「…………。 　これがほかの人間の台詞だったら、へたな 気遣いするなって言うとこだけど」
花枝「なんも言えない。 　この姉は本気・・だ。ただ単に」
香奈枝「ＹＥＳ」
花枝「『精神状態が普通ではない人』という意味 の単語をわたしが今あんたに向かって言った と思いなさい」
香奈枝「あなたに言われるとへこむ単語ねー……」
花枝「父さんの仇討ちまで独り占めする気？」
香奈枝「妹のものは姉のもの。 　姉のものは姉のもの」
花枝「…………」
花枝「獅子吼はついさっき、あんたを迎え撃ちに 出ていった。 　たぶん、ホールに向かったんだと思う」
香奈枝「あら……そちらから来ましたのに。 　どこで入れ違いになったのかしら」
香奈枝「よっぽど縁が無いみたいね、あの男とは」
獅子吼「本当に縁が無ければ幸いだったがな。 　……生憎と、とっくに出会っている」
香奈枝「!?」
